notes.title: Linux Now Available + Patch Notes!
notes.notes:
Dear gang,

We bring you news today!

[h2]Linux Build is now available![/h2]

We're happy to announce that the game is now available on Linux systems. Thank you for waiting! ːirenesmileː

[h2]Patch Notes for v1.0.4.[/h2]

We also updated our [b]Windows[/b] version today to v1.0.4. Here's our patch notes:

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug wherein volume sliders are always set to 0 in the Options window.
[*] Fixed a bug wherein the Options window doesn't close when changes are applied.
[*] Fixed a bug wherein the game's fps locks to 30 whenever the Texture Quality is set to 540p.
[*] Fixed a bug wherein the game still runs in the background even though its setting is turned off.
[*] Fixed a bug Long chapter titles texts in the Save/Load Game window bleeds out from its text box.
[*] Fixed a bug wherein some texts in the Extras menu are still in English even though the language setting has been changed to another language.
[*] Fixed a bug wherein unlocking multiple achievements at the same time shows the same achievement name.
[*] Fixed a grammatical bug in the German localization, from "XX vor Monaten" to "Vor XX Monaten..."
[*] Updated the Perfect Gold Artbook DLC and fixed numerous text issues.
[/list]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1554350/Perfect_Gold__Digital_Artbook/
[h2]Upcoming:[/h2][list]
[*] Fixes for Simplified Chinese language
[*] Mobile Port
[/list]

Thank you so much for your continued patience! We're constantly improving the game for better experience! Please look forward to our next patch! ːmariongrinː

------
